title: Beatrix and the Debt
author: Mara Sterling
blurb: Hazel Kavanagh, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must burn the network that did the training before the summit convenes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
